entries.title: Direct Form II Transposed Biquad & IEEE 754 Denormal Flushing
entries.statement: Direct Form II Transposed biquad filters minimize floating-point accumulation overflow at low cutoff frequencies; flushing subnormals (< 1e-15) to 0.0 prevents x86/x64 CPU microcode stalls during reverb and filter decay tails.

entries.title: Steinberg VST3 Real-Time Audio Thread Separation (ADR-0008)
entries.statement: Never invoke LLM APIs, network sockets, mutex locks, or heap allocations inside IAudioProcessor::process(). All AI copilot parameter suggestions must originate in Plane 1, pass through IEditController in Plane 2, and enter Plane 3 via lock-free std::atomic or SPSC parameter queues.

entries.title: FL Studio 2025 (25.1.6.4997) Workstation Binary & .flp Chunk Provenance
entries.statement: Workstation FL64.exe (25.1.6.4997, SHA-256 prefix 273ECDC1C2421628) stores projects in FLhd (6-byte payload: format, channelCount, ppq) and FLdt event streams where event 0xC7 (199) encodes the ASCII/UTF-8 creator version.

entries.title: Unverified Internal FL Studio Undocumented Event IDs
entries.statement: Proprietary plugin state blobs inside FLdt events lack a public write specification from Image-Line; direct in-place .flp binary mutation is classified as UNSUPPORTED_FORBIDDEN to prevent silent project corruption.
